songs.title: Burn This Disco Out
songs.note: The closing track, and the most relentless thing on the record.
songs.feel: Dancing like the night is being scored to it.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Burn This Disco Out (Audio).mp3

songs.title: Don't Stop 'Til You Get Enough
songs.note: His first solo writing credit and his first solo number one.
songs.feel: The exact moment the floor stops being a floor.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Don't Stop 'Til You Get Enough (Official Video - Upscaled).mp3

songs.title: Get on the Floor
songs.note: A co-write with Louis Johnson of the Brothers Johnson.
songs.feel: The bassline doing most of the talking and all of the flirting.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Get on the Floor (Audio).mp3

songs.title: Girlfriend
songs.note: Written by Paul McCartney as a gift, produced by Quincy Jones.
songs.feel: A wink, a shrug, and someone new on your mind.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Girlfriend (Audio).mp3

songs.title: I Can't Help It
songs.note: Written by Stevie Wonder, who plays the keys.
songs.feel: Being quietly undone by someone and not minding at all.

files.name: Michael Jackson - I Can't Help It (Audio).mp3

songs.title: It's the Falling in Love
songs.note: A duet with Patti Austin, tucked near the end.
songs.feel: The easy, floating part of falling for someone.

files.name: Michael Jackson - It's the Falling in Love (Audio).mp3

songs.title: Off the Wall
songs.note: The album that made him a solo star instead of a former child star.
songs.feel: Leaving your own problems somewhere behind the bassline.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Off the Wall (Audio).mp3

songs.title: Rock with You
songs.note: Recorded in one take, warmth turned into a groove.
songs.feel: Close enough to hear someone breathe and not wanting them to move.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Rock With You (Official Video - Upscaled).mp3

songs.title: She's Out of My Life
songs.note: He cried in the vocal booth and they kept the take.
songs.feel: The silence after a door closes, and knowing it is real.

files.name: Michael Jackson - She's Out of My Life (Official Video - Upscaled).mp3

songs.title: Sunset Driver
songs.note: An Off the Wall outtake, released decades later.
songs.feel: Top down, engine running, nowhere to be until morning.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Sunset Driver (Demo - Official Audio).mp3

songs.title: Workin' Day and Night
songs.note: He wrote and arranged it himself at twenty.
songs.feel: Grinding through it anyway because stopping is not an option.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Workin' Day and Night (Audio).mp3

songs.title: Baby Be Mine
songs.note: The deep cut Thriller fans argue about most.
songs.feel: Easy desire, no danger in it at all.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Baby Be Mine (Audio).mp3

songs.title: Beat It
songs.note: The Eddie Van Halen solo nobody was supposed to know about.
songs.feel: Walking away from a fight you could win, on your own terms.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Beat It (Official 4K Video).mp3

songs.title: Billie Jean
songs.note: The bassline that made Quincy Jones want to kill the drummer.
songs.feel: A secret following you home that will not take no for an answer.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Billie Jean (Official Video).mp3

songs.title: Can't Get Outta the Rain
songs.note: The B-side of The Girl Is Mine.
songs.feel: Standing in bad weather you cannot talk your way out of.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Can't Get Outta The Rain (Official Audio).mp3

songs.title: Carousel
songs.note: A Thriller outtake that surfaced on later reissues.
songs.feel: A fairground ride that feels like a memory while it is happening.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Carousel (Official Audio).mp3

songs.title: Human Nature
songs.note: Written for Toto, kept for Thriller, and he fought to keep it.
songs.feel: A late drive with the windows down and nowhere to be.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Human Nature (Official Audio).mp3

songs.title: P.Y.T.
songs.note: Stands for Pretty Young Thing, and he built the synth bed himself.
songs.feel: Flirting at full volume with absolutely no restraint.
aliases: p y t pretty young thing

files.name: Michael Jackson - P.Y.T. (Pretty Young Thing) (Official Audio).mp3

songs.title: She's Trouble
songs.note: A Thriller-era demo credited to Bill Bottrell.
songs.feel: Knowing better and going anyway, with a grin.

files.name: Michael Jackson - She's Trouble (Demo - Official Audio).mp3

songs.title: The Girl Is Mine
songs.note: The McCartney duet where they argue over a girl like schoolkids.
songs.feel: Gentle, funny, and completely unserious about itself.

files.name: Michael Jackson - The Girl Is Mine (Official Audio).mp3

songs.title: The Lady in My Life
songs.note: The quiet closer of the biggest album ever made.
songs.feel: Saying the tender thing out loud, slowly, and staying.

files.name: Michael Jackson - The Lady in My Life (Audio).mp3

songs.title: Thriller
songs.note: The only pop song that turned a horror movie voiceover into a dance routine.
songs.feel: Being deliciously scared because you know it is only a ride.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Thriller (Official 4K Video).mp3

songs.title: Wanna Be Startin' Somethin'
songs.note: Opens Thriller with a 90-second chant that refuses to settle.
songs.feel: Too much energy to sit still and too much edge to relax.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Wanna Be Startin' Somethin' (Audio).mp3

songs.title: Another Part of Me
songs.note: A Captain EO song that outgrew the theme park.
songs.feel: Realising you belong to something larger and it feels good.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Another Part of Me (Official Video).mp3

songs.title: Bad
songs.note: The 18-minute short film that changed what a music video could be.
songs.feel: Proving something to someone who stopped listening years ago.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Bad (Official Video).mp3

songs.title: Dirty Diana
songs.note: Diana Ross reportedly told him she loved it.
songs.feel: Wanting the thing you already know is a bad idea.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Dirty Diana (Official Video).mp3

songs.title: I Just Can't Stop Loving You
songs.note: The first single from Bad, a duet with Siedah Garrett.
songs.feel: A promise that does not waver, even when it probably should.

files.name: Michael Jackson, Siedah Garrett - I Just Can't Stop Loving You (Official Audio).mp3

songs.title: Just Good Friends
songs.note: A Stevie Wonder duet about a romance that fizzled into friendship.
songs.feel: Being grown-up about it, mostly, and only slightly annoyed.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Just Good Friends (Audio).mp3

songs.title: Leave Me Alone
songs.note: A middle finger to the tabloids, delivered as a fairground ride.
songs.feel: Being talked about so much you stop feeling like a person.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Leave Me Alone (Official Video).mp3

songs.title: Liberian Girl
songs.note: The video had 40 celebrities waiting to say one line to camera.
songs.feel: Loving someone from far away, gently and without demands.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Liberian Girl (Official Video).mp3

songs.title: Man in the Mirror
songs.note: He stopped mid-session, told everyone to leave, and finished it alone.
songs.feel: Turning to face yourself and deciding to actually change.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Man In The Mirror (Official Video).mp3

songs.title: Smooth Criminal
songs.note: That forward lean was done with a hidden harness and a lot of practice.
songs.feel: Piecing together what happened in a room you never saw.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Smooth Criminal (Official Video).mp3

songs.title: Speed Demon
songs.note: The claymation chase that followed the Bad video.
songs.feel: Too fast to think, and choosing to keep going faster.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Speed Demon (Official Video).mp3

songs.title: The Way You Make Me Feel
songs.note: The shimmy on the street that took a whole day to shoot.
songs.feel: The giddy, undignified joy of wanting someone who is right there.

files.name: Michael Jackson - The Way You Make Me Feel (Official Video).mp3

songs.title: Black or White
songs.note: The morphing faces segment pulled the video from some networks.
songs.feel: Loud, joyful refusal to accept a line between people.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Black or White (Official Video - Upscaled).mp3

songs.title: Can't Let Her Get Away
songs.note: A Teddy Riley production with a very long fade.
songs.feel: Holding on past the point where it is good for you.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Can't Let Her Get Away (Audio).mp3

songs.title: Dangerous
songs.note: The title track was released as a single eight years later.
songs.feel: The pull of something that is clearly trouble.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Dangerous (Audio).mp3

songs.title: Give In to Me
songs.note: Slash on guitar, and a vocal that sounds genuinely unhinged.
songs.feel: Wrestling with something that is winning.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Give In To Me (Official Video - Upscaled).mp3

songs.title: Gone Too Soon
songs.note: Written for Ryan White and performed at Bill Clinton’s inauguration.
songs.feel: The particular ache of a life that ended far too early.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Gone Too Soon (Official Video).mp3

songs.title: Heal the World
songs.note: He founded a charity with the same name the year it came out.
songs.feel: Wanting, very simply, for the world to stop hurting itself.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Heal The World (Official Video).mp3

songs.title: In the Closet
songs.note: Credited to Mystery Girl, who turned out to be Princess Stephanie.
songs.feel: Something you want that you are not supposed to want out loud.

files.name: Michael Jackson - In the Closet (Official Video - Upscaled).mp3

songs.title: Jam
songs.note: A Heavy D rap and a basketball court, and the album opens.
songs.feel: Panic with a beat, or a beat that keeps panic at bay.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Jam (Official Video - Upscaled).mp3

songs.title: Keep the Faith
songs.note: A gospel choir he assembled and directed himself.
songs.feel: Standing back up because someone told you it was still possible.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Keep the Faith (Audio).mp3

songs.title: Remember the Time
songs.note: The nine-minute desert court video with Eddie Murphy and Iman.
songs.feel: Missing someone from a time that felt easier than now.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Remember the Time (Official Video - Upscaled).mp3

songs.title: She Drives Me Wild
songs.note: Built on a drum loop and a car-engine sample.
songs.feel: Wanting someone so loudly it drowns out everything else.

files.name: Michael Jackson - She Drives Me Wild (Audio).mp3

songs.title: Who Is It
songs.note: Dedicated to his mother, and one of his own favourites.
songs.feel: The floor dropping when you realise who it was all along.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Who Is It (Official Video - Upscaled).mp3

songs.title: Why You Wanna Trip on Me
songs.note: Directed at a world obsessed with his life and blind to its own.
songs.feel: The exhaustion of being judged while nobody looks at themselves.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Why You Wanna Trip on Me (Audio).mp3

songs.title: Will You Be There
songs.note: The Free Willy theme, with a spoken outro taken from his own poem.
songs.feel: Asking, quietly, to be held, and half-expecting no.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Will You Be There (Official Video - Upscaled).mp3

songs.title: 2 Bad
songs.note: A rapper, a boxer, and a very fast bassline.
songs.feel: Telling someone to bring it, because you are done flinching.

files.name: Michael Jackson - 2 Bad (Audio).mp3

songs.title: Childhood
songs.note: The one he wanted people to hear before they judged him.
songs.feel: Explaining a wound you never chose and cannot fully describe.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Childhood (Official Video).mp3

songs.title: Come Together
songs.note: A Beatles cover recorded for the Moonwalker film.
songs.feel: A crowd of people finding the same groove at the same time.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Come Together (Official Video).mp3

songs.title: D.S.
songs.note: A blunt, furious character assassination set to a hard rock riff.
songs.feel: Rage with a name attached to it.

files.name: Michael Jackson - D.S. (Audio).mp3

songs.title: Earth Song
songs.note: The UK Christmas number one, and never a US single.
songs.feel: Grief for something being lost that cannot argue back.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Earth Song (Official Video).mp3

songs.title: HIStory
songs.note: The song the album is named after, more question than statement.
songs.feel: Trying to work out what any of it was for.

files.name: Michael Jackson - History (Audio).mp3

songs.title: Little Susie
songs.note: Built on a melody he had hummed since childhood.
songs.feel: The stillness of something unthinkably sad and very small.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Little Susie ⧸ Pie Jesu (Audio).mp3

songs.title: Money
songs.note: Opens with a recording of a slot machine.
songs.feel: Watching people choose the cash and stop pretending otherwise.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Money (Audio).mp3

songs.title: Scream
songs.note: The most expensive music video ever made, with Janet.
songs.feel: Fury that finally found a rhythm instead of a wall.

files.name: Michael Jackson, Janet Jackson - Scream (Official Video).mp3

songs.title: Stranger in Moscow
songs.note: Written in a Moscow hotel room during a very bad week.
songs.feel: Rain on a window in a city where nobody knows your name.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Stranger In Moscow (Official Video).mp3

songs.title: Tabloid Junkie
songs.note: An argument with the press, spelled out in the liner notes.
songs.feel: Reading a lie about yourself and feeling your jaw tighten.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Tabloid Junkie (Audio).mp3

songs.title: They Don't Care About Us
songs.note: The lyrics were edited in some pressings; he called the edits antisemitic.
songs.feel: The roar of being failed by a system and saying so anyway.

files.name: Michael Jackson - They Don't Care About Us.mp3

songs.title: This Time Around
songs.note: A Notorious B.I.G. verse sits in the middle of it.
songs.feel: Done being nice about it, and saying so plainly.

files.name: Michael Jackson - This Time Around (Audio).mp3

songs.title: You Are Not Alone
songs.note: The only song to debut at number one on the Hot 100 until 1997.
songs.feel: Someone reaching for your hand in the dark, and finding it.

files.name: Michael Jackson - You Are Not Alone (Official Video).mp3

songs.title: Blood on the Dance Floor
songs.note: The best-selling remix album of all time.
songs.feel: Something dangerous wearing dancing shoes.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Blood On The Dance Floor (Official Video).mp3

songs.title: Ghosts
songs.note: He wrote, directed and choreographed the short film himself.
songs.feel: Being the thing everyone is frightened of and not knowing why.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Ghosts (Official Video - Shortened Version).mp3

songs.title: Is It Scary
songs.note: A song about being the monster in other people’s stories.
songs.feel: Asking whether you are frightening or just frightened.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Is It Scary (Audio).mp3

songs.title: Morphine
songs.note: A jarring, genuinely unsettling industrial track.
songs.feel: A nerve that will not stop firing.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Morphine (Audio).mp3

songs.title: 2000 Watts
songs.note: A low, growling vocal he rarely used anywhere else.
songs.feel: Dialled all the way up with the knobs pulled off.

files.name: Michael Jackson - 2000 Watts (Audio).mp3

songs.title: Break of Dawn
songs.note: A soft landing two songs into the album.
songs.feel: Waking up next to someone with nowhere to be.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Break of Dawn (Official Audio).mp3

songs.title: Butterflies
songs.note: Reached the R&B top forty without ever being a single.
songs.feel: The soft, endless middle of being in love.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Butterflies (Audio).mp3

songs.title: Cry
songs.note: A gospel plea for the world, with a choir recorded in a single room.
songs.feel: Sorrow that still believes things could change.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Cry (Official Video).mp3

songs.title: Don't Walk Away
songs.note: A quiet plea that never became a single.
songs.feel: Asking someone to stay without any leverage left.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Don't Walk Away (Audio).mp3

songs.title: Heartbreaker
songs.note: A beat built to sound like a text message going unanswered.
songs.feel: The anger that arrives right after the sadness.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Heartbreaker (Audio).mp3

songs.title: Heaven Can Wait
songs.note: One of the most-covered songs he wrote late in his career.
songs.feel: Bargaining for a little more time with someone you love.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Heaven Can Wait (Official Audio).mp3

songs.title: Invincible
songs.note: The title track, never released as a single.
songs.feel: Knowing exactly who you are and refusing to argue about it.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Invincible (Audio).mp3

songs.title: Privacy
songs.note: The last song on the album, and the angriest.
songs.feel: The rage of having no door left to close.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Privacy (Audio).mp3

songs.title: Speechless
songs.note: A cappella opening, and a choir he built from his own voice.
songs.feel: Being so grateful it briefly stops the words.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Speechless (Audio).mp3

songs.title: The Lost Children
songs.note: The most personal song on his last album of new material.
songs.feel: Looking out for the ones nobody else looked out for.

files.name: Michael Jackson - The Lost Children (Audio).mp3

songs.title: Threatened
songs.note: Rod Serling narrates, tying it back to Thriller.
songs.feel: Something circling that you cannot quite see yet.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Threatened (Audio).mp3

songs.title: Unbreakable
songs.note: Opens Invincible with a Biggie verse cleared after his death.
songs.feel: Scarred, and entirely unwilling to be finished off.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Unbreakable (Audio).mp3

songs.title: Whatever Happens
songs.note: A Carlos Santana guitar line floats through the whole thing.
songs.feel: Holding on to something while bracing for the worst.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Whatever Happens (Audio).mp3

songs.title: You Are My Life
songs.note: Written for his children.
songs.feel: The plainest, most certain kind of love there is.

files.name: Michael Jackson - You Are My Life (Audio).mp3

songs.title: You Rock My World
songs.note: A cinematic video with Marlon Brando in his final film appearance.
songs.feel: Walking into a room and having the night get better immediately.

files.name: Michael Jackson - You Rock My World (Official Video).mp3

songs.title: One More Chance
songs.note: The last original single released in his lifetime.
songs.feel: Asking one last time, and knowing the answer.

files.name: Michael Jackson - One More Chance (Official Video).mp3

songs.title: We've Had Enough
songs.note: A protest song about a killing that never made an album.
songs.feel: Grief that turned into a demand.

files.name: Michael Jackson - We've Had Enough (Audio).mp3

songs.title: Thriller (Steve Aoki Midnight Hour Remix)
songs.note: The remix that put Thriller back on dancefloors 25 years later.
songs.feel: The same horror story, told at four in the morning.
aliases: thriller steve aoki midnight hour remix

files.name: Michael Jackson - Thriller (Steve Aoki Midnight Hour Remix) (Audio).mp3

songs.title: This Is It
songs.note: Heard for the first time in the film that followed his death.
songs.feel: An almost-there promise, which is what makes it ache.

files.name: Michael Jackson - This Is It (Official Video).mp3

songs.title: (I Like) The Way You Love Me
songs.note: Grew out of a voice memo he recorded at home.
songs.feel: The uncomplicated pleasure of being loved well.
aliases: i like the way you love me

files.name: Michael Jackson - (I Like) The Way You Love Me (Audio).mp3

songs.title: Behind the Mask
songs.note: A Yellow Magic Orchestra song he demoed in 1982, finished decades later.
songs.feel: A crowd with its hands up and no reason to stop.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Behind the Mask (Official Video).mp3

songs.title: Hold My Hand
songs.note: A duet with Akon, finished after his death.
songs.feel: Two people deciding to get through it together.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Hold My Hand (Duet with Akon) (Official Video) ft. Akon.mp3

songs.title: Hollywood Tonight
songs.note: A song about a girl chasing a dream that is already eating her.
songs.feel: Chasing a city that has not decided to want you back.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Hollywood Tonight (Official Video).mp3

songs.title: The Toy
songs.note: The original demo that became Best of Joy.
songs.feel: The child inside the song still holding the toy.

files.name: Michael Jackson - The Toy (Demo - Official Audio).mp3

songs.title: What a Lovely Way to Go
songs.note: A keyboard demo that surfaced posthumously.
songs.feel: A wry shrug at the end of something long.

files.name: Michael Jackson - What A Lovely Way To Go (Demo - Official Audio).mp3

songs.title: Who Do You Know
songs.note: An unfinished demo from the Invincible era.
songs.feel: Trying to place a face you should probably remember.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Who Do You Know (Demo - Official Audio).mp3

songs.title: Immortal Megamix
songs.note: The Cirque du Soleil show condensed into six minutes.
songs.feel: Every hit at once, with the tempo pushed up.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Immortal Megamix (Audio).mp3

songs.title: A Place With No Name
songs.note: A reworking of America’s A Horse with No Name.
songs.feel: An open road that asks no questions.

files.name: Michael Jackson - A Place With No Name (Official Video).mp3

songs.title: Blue Gangsta
songs.note: An Invincible-era demo about a man pushed past his limit.
songs.feel: The moment patience runs out and something else takes over.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Blue Gangsta (Audio).mp3

songs.title: Chicago
songs.note: A She Was Lovin’ Me demo rebuilt with a colder edge.
songs.feel: Finding out the whole thing was never what you thought.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Chicago (Official Audio).mp3

songs.title: Do You Know Where Your Children Are
songs.note: A song about children with nowhere safe to go.
songs.feel: Fear for someone small who cannot protect themselves.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Do You Know Where Your Children Are (Official Audio).mp3

songs.title: Love Never Felt So Good
songs.note: A 1983 demo with Paul Anka, finished for Xscape.
songs.feel: Being delighted by a feeling you had written off.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Love Never Felt So Good (Official Video).mp3

songs.title: Love Never Felt So Good (with Justin Timberlake)
songs.note: The duet version that put a posthumous single in the top ten.
songs.feel: The same delight, shared out loud with someone else.
aliases: love never felt so good with justin timberlake
classic mj x love never felt so good
love never felt so good justin timberlake

files.name: Michael Jackson, Justin Timberlake - Love Never Felt So Good (Audio).mp3

songs.title: Loving You
songs.note: A Bad-era demo finished by Timbaland for Xscape.
songs.feel: A simple, happy love that keeps its own time.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Loving You (Official Audio).mp3

songs.title: Slave to the Rhythm
songs.note: A Dangerous-era demo that finally surfaced.
songs.feel: Locked into a beat you did not choose.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Slave to the Rhythm (Official Audio).mp3

songs.title: Xscape
songs.note: The title track, unfinished for over a decade.
songs.feel: Running from something, on purpose, at speed.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Xscape (Official Audio).mp3

songs.title: Blood on the Dance Floor 2017
songs.note: A 2017 rework built for contemporary dancefloors.
songs.feel: The same danger, twenty years newer.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Blood On The Dance Floor 2017 (Official Video).mp3

songs.title: Blood on the Dance Floor x Dangerous
songs.album: Blood on the Dance Floor x Dangerous
songs.note: A mash-up of Blood on the Dance Floor with Dangerous.
songs.feel: Two bad ideas colliding on purpose.

files.name: Michael Jackson - Blood On The Dance Floor X Dangerous (The White Panda Mash-Up).mp3
